execution_note: Full browser gate, performance and media run separately from the inherited CLI workload. An initial projection review corrected wheel winding before final acceptance. A full browser run then passed 29/30, with one Codex Suspense fallback timeout despite a successful 7 ms module response. Room navigation now uses the established CSS entrance without root screenshot transitions, resolving Suspense and skip-focus timing races. Delayed-chunk/navigation repeats and the complete 30-group gate rerun. A subsequent rendering pass moves decorative ring animation outside the data SVG and removes costly filter/blend compositing; the final full browser gate covers this optimization. Afterwards Codex privacy/empty-state wording was aligned with Western snapshots and comparison-number text contrast corrected; two existing Codex accessibility/native-save groups were rechecked. Stills disable CSS animation during capture only; live recording and performance retain motion.
acceptance_criteria: Native result equals replay through unchanged future.tarot.read
One/three cards, reversals and source references preserved
Progressive reveal and skip path; duplicates blocked and retry seed retained
No automatic cloud transmission; chapter persistence requires explicit Save to this device
Pixi renders without console errors, animates, and stops on pause/reduced motion
Complete journeys and export in mobile browser; accessibility scans and keyboard dialog pass
Small/tablet/desktop and doubled-text control geometry checks pass
No-WebGL fallback completes a native reading
Existing native/Workbench tests, full CLI/verifier gates, production builds and inventory/dependency gates pass
All 54 retained inventory IDs, six exclusions and availability categories match frozen projection
Real native Numerology parity, independent arithmetic, explicit Y/name basis and unsupported context preserved
Complete three-seal ritual, immediate reading path, exact export, retry/duplicate guards and session-only continuity
Numerology live material transforms, keyboard touch, reduced motion and low-power pause checks
Separate signed Numerology consent; provider prompt excludes names and dates; no automatic cloud transmission or original-input storage
Native Western chart and source composition equal direct unchanged engine replay
Exact live SVG planet longitudes, twelve house cusps and aspects match native results
Unknown time blocked; DST gaps, explicit folds, IANA historical offsets and polar restrictions tested
Explicit chart snapshot excludes raw birth datetime, coordinates, timezone, place, receipt and commentary
Frozen Western source edition restores source components without chart/provider POSTs
Gemini requires signed per-chart consent and omits original birth inputs from provider prompt
Responsive 320/390/768/1440 chart, keyboard turn, pause/reduced/low-capability and source depth pass
Explicit local save excludes all original inputs, entered dates, traces, replay seeds and Gemini commentary
Frozen source edition reopens minimal chapters after refresh without new engine/provider POST requests
Unknown/corrupt/private-extra-key records fail closed; quota failures never fabricate saved status
Individual/all deletion preserves unrelated storage; other tabs refresh without stale chapter content
Real cover/leaf, source chapter navigation, keyboard/reduced motion and bounded responsive folios pass
Source-language comparison cites original themes, keeps alternatives separate and invents no agreement score or combined prediction
limitations: Local Chromium mobile/desktop emulation and software WebGL only; no physical iOS/Android, field CWV or actual INP certification
60 Hz is a target; sustained missed budgets reduce resolution and can select a 30 Hz low-power mode
No public deployment, distributed limiter, accounts or cloud sync; local chapters require explicit saving
Complete verified historical Archive Edition; a fully bespoke figurative FATE deck remains future artwork, never mixed into draws as placeholders
Gemini semantic faithfulness is not guaranteed
Software acceptance is not empirical prediction validation
Numerology direct themes cover Expression and Personal Year only; other numbers are context, never assigned unsupported meanings
Gallery upcoming status describes consumer availability only; no new engine or launch commitment
Numerology RAF cadence is main-thread scheduling evidence, not hardware compositor FPS; live provider semantic quality remains unverified
City points are approximate current GeoNames references; exact birthplace coordinates and historical timezone/birth-record accuracy need visitor verification
Western consumer room supports tropical modern natal components only; no unknown birth times, direct combined placement/planet-pair readings or event predictions
Derived saved chart geometry can reveal birth-moment information; size cap may bind before 50 chapters
Local records are unencrypted, editable and subject to browser clearing/quota/origin policies; no accounts, sync, automatic backup or import UI
Simultaneous cross-tab writes can conflict; explicit exports are the independent backup
Source-language comparison uses a bounded editorial vocabulary; lexical echoes are not independent corroboration
App/artwork must be available to reopen chapters; normal asset requests still reach the host
